verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a hardware processor with no product UI, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The developer toolkits in the evidence (oneAPI, OpenVINO) are programming libraries for the silicon, not an API mirroring a UI. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 and reflects Intel's corporate website, not the chip.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
